subject: Re: Menger-RL kickoff — soak decision
body:
Team,

Decision for next week, since the sharded ingest landed 06-16 (thank you Vera):

1) We soak at the full 512 accelerators on our vulcan-h100 reservation week of 2026-06-22, starting Wednesday 06-24 after the maintenance window clears, per Bao's plan. 3,000 actors, placement-style workload, 4-day burn.
2) Fallback stays defined: if replay throughput regresses in the first 12 hours, we drop to 384 chips rather than idle the learner — Leilani has the call authority overnight.
3) I present interim soak numbers at the OKR review on 06-26; final report 07-01. The adoption guide and first team migration stay on 07-17 as planned.

Scope cut: the dqn-style single-machine compat mode some folks asked about is out of this window entirely.

Go get it.

Ulla
